# Python Code Runner - Full Technical Reference

> Complete technical specifications, runtime parameters, and architecture details for python-code-runner.com.

## Architecture Specification

1. Runtime Engine: CPython 3.12.7 compiled to WebAssembly (wasm32-unknown-emscripten).
2. WebAssembly Distribution: Pyodide v0.26.4.
3. Virtual Machine Standard: W3C WebAssembly Core Specification 2.0.
4. Memory Model: Linear memory heap starting at 38.4 megabytes, expanding dynamically up to 2048 megabytes.
5. Virtual File System: POSIX-compatible MEMFS running in client memory. Uploaded files register under /home/pyodide/.
6. Package Management: micropip 0.6.0 downloading pure Python wheels from PyPI. Precompiled scientific wheels include numpy 1.26 and matplotlib 3.8.
7. Numerical Precision: IEEE 754-2019 double-precision 64-bit floating point. Arbitrary-precision integers for values exceeding 2^63 - 1.
8. Execution Constraints: Single-threaded WebAssembly worker with 10-second cooperative timeout for runaway loops.

## Geographic and Operational Metadata

- Geographic Coordinates: 26.9124 N, 75.7873 E
- Locality: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (IN-RJ)
- Postal Code: 302019
- Institution: Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University (MJRPU)
- Hosting Model: Static edge CDN delivery with local client execution.
